name: Surface
summary: A box that sets content on one step of the surface ladder: glass or an opaque panel floating over the map, a raised card inside a panel, or an inset box, each with its fill, edge, radius, shadow and padding from the tokens.
whenToUse: Use Surface for a box that only sets content on one step of the surface ladder: a panel floating over the map, a card inside a panel, or a box set into one.

alternatives.name: Dialog
alternatives.when: The panel opens over the screen and holds focus until it closes, with Esc and a backdrop

alternatives.name: Sheet
alternatives.when: The panel slides in from the edge of the screen, such as the overview or the detail panel

alternatives.name: Popover
alternatives.when: A small glass panel opens from a button and leaves the rest of the screen usable

alternatives.name: Section
alternatives.when: The content inside a panel needs a small heading, and an action beside it

alternatives.name: Alert
alternatives.when: The box says what is happening and how much it matters, in an intent's tinted colour

props.name: variant
props.description: The step of the surface ladder: `raised` for a card inside a panel, `inset` for a box or track set into one, `glass` for a panel floating over the map, `opaque` for a floating panel full of text on a phone, where glass would let the map show through.

props.name: children
props.description: The content the surface holds

props.name: className
props.description: Reaches the root; `className` is merged after `pn-Surface`

props.name: style
props.description: Reaches the root; `className` is merged after `pn-Surface`

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the root element, whichever element `render` makes it

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component. Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

rules.do: Use `glass` for a panel that floats over the map, and `opaque` for one full of text on a phone, as Elevation says.
rules.dont: Use `glass` over a plain background or inside another panel: the blur has nothing to soften, and glass on glass loses its edge.

rules.do: Put `raised` cards and `inset` boxes inside a panel, stepping down the ladder.
rules.dont: Nest a floating `glass` or `opaque` surface inside another surface, or add a shadow to a card with `className`: only floating panels cast one.

rules.do: Render it as `<section>` or `<aside>` with `aria-labelledby` on its heading when the box is a region someone navigates to.
rules.dont: Give every card a landmark element: a screen of unnamed regions is noisier than plain boxes.

rules.do: Use Dialog or Sheet for a panel that opens and closes over the screen, since they bring the focus, Esc and scrim.
rules.dont: Build a dialog from a `glass` Surface: it would look right and trap no focus.

rules.do: Say a state in words or with an icon inside the surface.
rules.dont: Tint a surface with a status colour through `className` to mean warning or success: colour is never alone.

rules.do: Change the padding through `className` with a `space.*` token when rows must run to the edge.
rules.dont: Set raw pixel padding, radius or colours on it, which leave the ladder and the themes behind.

name: Attribution
summary: Attribution is the map's credits: one small strip of caption text, laid on glass in a corner of the map, that names where the map and its data come from, such as "Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors", with the caller's links to each source.
whenToUse: Use Attribution for the map's credits: one strip in a corner of the map that names where the map and its data come from, with a link to each source's terms.

alternatives.name: SourceLine
alternatives.when: A panel names where its data comes from and the time of that data

props.name: children
props.description: The credits, as each source asks to be credited, with a link to each source's terms where it has one: "Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors". Phrasing content only: text, links and inline elements. Required: an empty strip credits no one.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component. Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

props.name: className
props.description: Joined after `pn-Attribution` on the root

props.name: style
props.description: Reaches the root

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the root element

rules.do: Credit each source as its terms ask, with a link to those terms: "Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors"
rules.dont: Shorten a credit a source's terms set, or leave the link out where the terms ask for one

rules.do: Place one Attribution in a corner of the map, `size.panel-gap` from the edge and stacked at `z-index.map-controls`, clear of the map controls and the scale
rules.dont: Put it in a panel, a dialog or the page's footer, away from the map it credits, or cover it with a sheet or a panel

rules.do: Give it phrasing content: text, links and inline elements
rules.dont: Put a heading, a paragraph or a list in it; a `<small>` holds phrasing content only

rules.do: Write each link's text as the source's name or the credit itself
rules.dont: Write "Click here" or "Read more", or a bare URL; the link's text is what a screen reader hears

rules.do: Keep it to the credits
rules.dont: Use it for a disclaimer, a data-state note or a status message; a status belongs in words beside what it is about, in its own component, with its own colour

name: MapControls
summary: The map's zoom in, zoom out and centre buttons, and, when the screen handles them, a 3D toggle, a compass that turns the map back to north and a pause button for the map's motion, in one glass bar that is one tab stop, named and labelled in the reader's language.
whenToUse: Use MapControls for the map's own buttons, zoom in, zoom out and centre, and the 3D toggle, the compass and the pause when the screen handles them, once per map.

alternatives.name: Toolbar
alternatives.when: Another map action, such as a layers switch, needs a bar of its own beside it

alternatives.name: IconButton
alternatives.when: One icon action sits on its own, on a panel, a sheet or the top bar

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which way the bar runs, and so which arrow keys move through it: Up and Down for `vertical`, the map's column at the bottom right; Left and Right for `horizontal`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether every button is disabled, such as while the map loads. The buttons stay focusable and in the arrow-key order.

props.name: zoomInDisabled
props.description: Whether the zoom in button is disabled, at the map's closest zoom. It stays focusable and announces that it is dimmed, and a click fires no `onZoomIn`.

props.name: zoomOutDisabled
props.description: Whether the zoom out button is disabled, at the map's farthest zoom. It stays focusable and announces that it is dimmed, and a click fires no `onZoomOut`.

props.name: centerMapDisabled
props.description: Whether the centre button is disabled, such as before the map can be moved, while the pause button stays enabled. It stays focusable and announces that it is dimmed, and a click fires no `onCenterMap`.

props.name: onZoomIn
props.description: Called when the zoom in button is pressed, by click, Enter or Space, with the click event. The screen zooms the map in by one step.

props.name: onZoomOut
props.description: Called when the zoom out button is pressed, by click, Enter or Space, with the click event. The screen zooms the map out by one step.

props.name: onCenterMap
props.description: Called when the centre button is pressed, by click, Enter or Space, with the click event. The screen moves and zooms the map to show the whole network.

props.name: paused
props.description: Whether the map's motion is paused, held by the screen. The pause button shows the `play` icon and is named "Resume" while it is `true`, and the `pause` icon and "Pause" while it is `false`.

props.name: onPausedChange
props.description: Called when the pause button is pressed, by click, Enter or Space, with the click event and the state the press asks for: `true` while the map moves, `false` while it is paused. Given, it adds the pause button after the centre button; the screen stops or starts the map's motion and passes the new `paused`.

props.name: tilted
props.description: Whether the map is tilted into 3D, held by the screen, by the 3D toggle or a gesture alike. The 3D toggle is pressed, `aria-pressed="true"` on its on fill, while it is `true`.

props.name: onTiltedChange
props.description: Called when the 3D toggle is pressed, by click, Enter or Space, with the click event and the state the press asks for: `true` while the map is flat, `false` while it is tilted. Given, it adds the 3D toggle after the centre button; the screen tilts the map or lays it flat and passes the new `tilted`.

props.name: heading
props.description: The map's heading in degrees, its bearing clockwise from north, held by the screen. The compass's needle turns by minus `heading`, so it points to north on the map, and the compass is described as turned away from north while it is turned; a value that isn't finite points it up.

props.name: onResetNorth
props.description: Called when the compass is pressed, by click, Enter or Space, with the click event. Given, it adds the compass after the centre button, and after the 3D toggle when there is one; the screen turns the map back to north and passes the new `heading`.

props.name: mapControlsLabel
props.description: Overrides "Map controls", the bar's name.

props.name: zoomInLabel
props.description: Overrides "Zoom in", the zoom in button's name.

props.name: zoomOutLabel
props.description: Overrides "Zoom out", the zoom out button's name.

props.name: centerMapLabel
props.description: Overrides "Centre the map", the centre button's name.

props.name: pauseLabel
props.description: Overrides "Pause", the pause button's name while the map moves.

props.name: resumeLabel
props.description: Overrides "Resume", the pause button's name while the map is paused.

props.name: view3dLabel
props.description: Overrides "3D view", the 3D toggle's name.

props.name: resetNorthLabel
props.description: Overrides "Reset to north", the compass's name.

props.name: turnedFromNorthLabel
props.description: Overrides "Map turned away from north", the compass's description while the map is turned.

props.name: className
props.description: Reaches the root, the `role="toolbar"` element. `className` is merged after `pn-Toolbar` and `pn-MapControls`.

props.name: style
props.description: Reaches the root, the `role="toolbar"` element. `className` is merged after `pn-Toolbar` and `pn-MapControls`.

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the root, the `role="toolbar"` element. `className` is merged after `pn-Toolbar` and `pn-MapControls`.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: If `true`, using keyboard navigation will wrap focus to the other end of the toolbar once the end is reached.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component. Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

rules.do: Use MapControls for the map's zoom and centre buttons, once per map
rules.dont: Build the same bar from IconButtons or from your own Toolbar: an IconButton in a toolbar adds a tab stop, and a second copy drifts from this one

rules.do: Place it from the screen, at the bottom right, `size.panel-gap` from the edges, at `z-index.map-controls`
rules.dont: Expect MapControls to position itself, or give it a `z-index` through the component: it sizes to its content and the screen places it

rules.do: Set `zoomInDisabled` or `zoomOutDisabled` when the map reaches a zoom limit
rules.dont: Hide or unmount a button at a limit: focus on it is lost and the bar changes shape under the pointer

rules.do: Centre the map on the whole network in `onCenterMap`, as its words promise
rules.dont: Wire it to the reader's own location: its words, "Centre the map", and the `locate` icon's use promise the network

rules.do: Rename the bar or a button with its `…Label` prop, such as `zoomInLabel`
rules.dont: Pass `aria-label` to the root: the bar's own name is set after it and replaces it

rules.do: Bind `+` and `−` on the map canvas, where Accessibility puts them
rules.dont: Expect MapControls to listen for keys: it adds none beyond the toolbar's arrows

rules.do: Give `onPausedChange` and `paused` to add the pause button, and set `paused` from the handler
rules.dont: Put the pause in a Toolbar of its own beside MapControls: it is the map's own control, and a bar of its own adds a second bar and a second tab stop

rules.do: Put another map action, such as a layers switch, in a Toolbar of its own beside it
rules.dont: Wrap MapControls to add buttons inside it: it takes no `children`, so its buttons stay the same on every screen; only the map's own controls, the 3D toggle, the compass and the pause, join the bar

rules.do: Give `onTiltedChange` and `tilted` to add the 3D toggle, and set `tilted` from the map's own tilt, whether the rider tilted it with the toggle or a gesture
rules.dont: Set `tilted` only in the handler: a gesture that tilts the map then leaves the toggle off, and the ear hears "not pressed" over a tilted map

rules.do: Give `onResetNorth` and `heading` to add the compass, pass the map's bearing in degrees clockwise from north at each frame of a turn, and turn the map back to north in the handler, with the motion tokens' reduced values when the system asks for less motion
rules.dont: Pass the needle's own angle, a counter-clockwise or radian value, or only the heading the turn ends at: the needle turns by minus `heading` and jumps to each value it is given

rules.do: Keep the compass in the bar at north
rules.dont: Unmount the compass or drop `onResetNorth` while the map faces north: the pause button moves under the pointer and the rider can't find the compass when the map is first turned

name: Link
summary: A link in text: words, in a sentence or standing alone, that take the reader to another page or place, such as "Departures from Rejseplanen" or "Show all departures", underlined in the colour of the text around them.
whenToUse: Use Link for words that take the reader to another page or place, in a sentence or standing alone, such as "Departures from Rejseplanen".

alternatives.name: LinkButton
alternatives.when: The link stands apart, shaped like a button, such as "Back to the map"

alternatives.name: Button
alternatives.when: Pressing it runs an action on the screen it sits on

props.name: href
props.description: Where the link goes: a URL or a path. Give it on every Link, unless `render` gives a router's link that brings its own destination.

props.name: children
props.description: The link's words, which name where it goes: "Rejseplanen", "Show all departures". Phrasing content only. Required in practice: a link with no words has no name.

props.name: className
props.description: Reaches the root; `className` is merged after `pn-Link`.

props.name: style
props.description: Reaches the root; `className` is merged after `pn-Link`.

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the root element.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component. Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

rules.do: Use Link for a link in text, in a sentence or standing alone, and [LinkButton](link-button.md) for one shaped like a button
rules.dont: Put a LinkButton in running text: its height and padding break the line

rules.do: Use Link when pressing it goes somewhere: another page, another place in the app, another site
rules.dont: Use Link to run an action, such as showing a line or closing a panel, with an `onClick` that prevents the link: that is a Button

rules.do: Name where it goes, in the words of the sentence: "Departures from Rejseplanen", "Show all departures"
rules.dont: Write "Click here", "Read more" or a bare URL: the link's words are all a screen reader hears of it in a list of links (WCAG 2.2, 2.4.4 Link purpose)

rules.do: Set the colour and type on the text around the link, and let Link take them
rules.dont: Recolour a Link in the brand yellow or a status colour on its own: brand is never a link ([Intents](README.md#intents)), and the text's colour already carries any meaning

rules.do: Give a standalone link `size.target-min` of room, such as a row of that height or a gap around it
rules.dont: Set a standalone link against another target, where a 21 px line leaves too small a mark to press

rules.do: Give a router's link through `render`, such as `render={<RouterLink to="/departures" />}`, so the app's navigation runs
rules.dont: Wrap a Link in a router link, or a router link in a Link: two nested `<a>` elements are invalid and make two tab stops

rules.do: Name a site the link leaves Mylder for, and keep Mylder's own links in the same tab
rules.dont: Open a new tab without saying where the link goes

rules.do: Leave a link out when there is nowhere to go yet
rules.dont: Render a Link without `href` or `render`, or fake a disabled one with `opacity`: an `<a>` with no `href` is not a link, and disabled is a colour

name: Tabs
summary: A row of tabs that switches between views of one thing, one panel showing at a time, such as a stop's departures, its lines and its disruptions in the detail panel.
whenToUse: Use Tabs to switch between views of one thing, one panel showing at a time, such as a stop's departures, its lines and its disruptions.

alternatives.name: SegmentedControl
alternatives.when: The choice changes how one view shows its content, such as departures by mode

alternatives.name: FilterChip
alternatives.when: Filters narrow one view, each turned on and off on its own

alternatives.name: Accordion
alternatives.when: Headed sections stack down the page, each opening its content under its heading

alternatives.name: LinkButton
alternatives.when: The control goes to another screen or page

props.name: value
props.description: The selected tab's `value`, when the caller controls it. `null` selects no tab.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The tab selected at first, when Tabs keeps the value itself. Left out, the first enabled tab is selected, and `onChange` reports it with `details.reason` `'initial'`.

props.name: onChange
props.type: (event: Event, value: string | null, details: Tabs.Root.ChangeEventDetails) => void
props.description: Called when the selected tab changes: by a click, Enter or Space, or an arrow key with `activateOnFocus` on (`details.reason` `'none'`); and by Tabs itself, at mount when `defaultValue` is left out (`'initial'`), or when the selected tab is disabled or removed (`'disabled'`, `'missing'`). `event` is `details.event`.
